description: Box is a cloud content management and collaboration platform for storing, sharing, and governing files and enterprise content. It also provides AI and workflow features that operate on content stored in Box.
summary: Box exposes a REST Platform API at `https://api.box.com/2.0`, a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.box.com`, and the `box` CLI; all require Box-issued OAuth-based credentials or access tokens.
